strictInputRules.actualPopularityUse: teacher label only; each race excluded from its own estimator training
strictInputRules.nonStarterHandling: cancelled/excluded horses are retained in pre-race prediction candidates but omitted from final-popularity teacher rows and validation metrics
strictInputRules.indexDetailHistoryCutoff: previous-run/detail indices use only archived race results with date < target race date
strictInputRules.raceConditionMetadataFallback: surface/distance may fall back to target result metadata or an authoritative race-program override; if still missing, course index degrades neutrally instead of aborting. Target result performance is never used
strictInputRules.indexDetailFailurePolicy: non-critical modal-index exceptions fall back to validated pre-race scores; critical race input errors are collected across all races and reported together
